notes.text: A discount left blank is read as no discount (Nil).
A discount period runs from the later of the day the invoice is received and the day payment falls due.
A discount may have at most two decimal places. A reviewer reads it for this; no rule can check a number's precision yet.
Part D asks for the bank account payments go to: the bank's name and address, the account name and number, and the sorting code.

rules.condition: the tenderer is based outside the jurisdiction and will be paid by telegraphic transfer
